subject.title: Nix: speed up gateway builds and enforce cache-only CI consumers

question: Should this maintainer-authored PR be closed because v2026.7.1 already ships the same gateway packaging optimization with additional symlink repair?
rationale: The technical necessity is resolved, but ClawSweeper cannot close work authored by a repository MEMBER without explicit maintainer judgment.

options.title: Close as already shipped
options.body: Close the conflicted branch because current main and v2026.7.1 contain the intended optimization plus later hardening.

options.title: Keep as provenance
options.body: Keep the PR open only if maintainers specifically want its discussion and measurements preserved as an active review vehicle.

recommendation.title: Close as already shipped
recommendation.body: Close the conflicted branch because current main and v2026.7.1 contain the intended optimization plus later hardening.

likelyOwner.reason: They defined the current packaging-only scope and are the strongest available routing candidate to confirm that the main implementation supersedes the branch.
